cases.trigger: Authorized new pack; no current integrator.
cases.expected: Bind consumer/mandate/engineering route; fresh first integrator selects usable milestone.
cases.forbidden: Coordinator reads the whole source tree and implements first.

cases.trigger: Matching milestone-complete return; evidence refs and native quiescence accounted for.
cases.expected: Consume once and dispatch a distinct fresh integrator with current continuation.
cases.forbidden: Resume the retired integrator for unrelated next work.

cases.trigger: Current milestone has a reproduced review finding.
cases.expected: Resume the same current integrator with finding and current authority.
cases.forbidden: Fresh agent per review comment or coordinator edits the fix.

cases.trigger: Wait expires while the same child remains active.
cases.expected: Continue supported native waiting; act only on a real interruption.
cases.forbidden: Spawn replacement, poll transcript, or invent useful coordinator work.

cases.trigger: Native turn limit returns continue-milestone with accounted partial changes.
cases.expected: Continue same integrator without declaring milestone or pack complete.
cases.forbidden: Treat max turns as acceptance or blindly replay all prior commands.

cases.trigger: Already consumed terminal result is delivered again.
cases.expected: Ignore duplicate disposition for that exact dispatch.
cases.forbidden: Start another successor.

cases.trigger: A result consumed mandate 1; user mandate 2 narrows scope.
cases.expected: Forward current amendment; require relevant reconciliation before continuing.
cases.forbidden: Dispatch now-prohibited work from stale recommendation.

cases.trigger: User cancels while a writer is active.
cases.expected: Stop task-owned work where supported; preserve and report partial/unknown effects.
cases.forbidden: Automatic resume, replacement writer, or cancellation interpreted as retry.

cases.trigger: Success result arrives while a child command still writes.
cases.expected: Retain current ownership until effects and descendants are accounted for.
cases.forbidden: Successor begins overlapping edits.

cases.trigger: Integrator terminates without a usable result; effects unknown.
cases.expected: Establish inactive old writers and inspect effects before a bounded recovery assignment.
cases.forbidden: Replay mutation or assume an absent result means nothing changed.

cases.trigger: Required visual approval pending; independent persistence milestone eligible.
cases.expected: Keep candidate protected and required acceptance open; continue independent work.
cases.forbidden: Stop entire pack early or fabricate approval.

cases.trigger: No eligible independent work remains; required human decision pending.
cases.expected: Return exact candidate/ask with unresolved criteria; unattended boundary is reached.
cases.forbidden: Mark pack Auto-Verified or keep reasoning in a waiting loop.

cases.trigger: User asks for status, not implementation.
cases.expected: Read scoped live state and report; no agent spawn or mutation.
cases.forbidden: Full pack workflow or model family starts.

cases.trigger: One small coupled fix is authorized.
cases.expected: One milestone integrator implements/checks directly; one compact closeout.
cases.forbidden: Mandatory workers, scouts, repeated review, or milestone fragmentation.

cases.trigger: Fresh child supported but integrator cannot spawn leaves.
cases.expected: Qualified integrator-direct path; preserve required independent review via supported narrow relay or leave unmet.
cases.forbidden: External headless/API replacement or silently skip required review.

cases.trigger: Native child effective effort is low because a global/main setting overrides intended engineering effort.
cases.expected: Report mismatch, reconcile supported selection before claiming intended route.
cases.forbidden: Treat generated request/banner as observed runtime proof.

cases.trigger: Ordinary implementation worker receives its complete slice.
cases.expected: Use retained standard route and exclusive ownership, perform local checks, return result.
cases.forbidden: Nested integrator creation, board acceptance or unassigned staging/commits.

cases.trigger: Interactive host ended; later authorized invocation resumes.
cases.expected: Recover original mandate/baseline and live board; reconcile prior ownership before writing.
cases.forbidden: Promise external restart or reset RFC_BASE_SHA.

cases.trigger: User asks to review a candidate without implementation.
cases.expected: Read-only review assignment scoped to candidate and requested criteria.
cases.forbidden: Implementation, card finish or commit inferred from review request.

cases.trigger: Human submits one rejection, then hands back with other candidates unanswered.
cases.expected: Consume actual decision once, preserve other candidates and required undecided work; correct relevant scope.
cases.forbidden: Treat hand-back as approval, discard note/image, or unlock unrelated protected candidates.

cases.trigger: Rollout changed coordinator model, topology and instructions together.
cases.expected: Report combined rollout observation and all-in family usage; preserve existing strict experiment rules.
cases.forbidden: Label as matched one-factor experiment or causal quota saving.

cases.trigger: Coordinator, two integrator generations and their leaves have owning response records plus duplicate counters.
cases.expected: Count each unique owned response once across transitive family; report conflicts/gaps.
cases.forbidden: Count only immediate children, add cumulative totals or treat missing outcomes as zero.

cases.trigger: All required selected criteria have actual relevant evidence; writers quiescent.
cases.expected: Integrator performs existing truthful closeout; coordinator relays outcome.
cases.forbidden: Fresh mandatory re-review, broader unrequested matrix, or context pressure as completion.

cases.trigger: Old settled RFC assets contain prior primary-only policy and exact role fixtures.
cases.expected: Reconcile active workflow and live tests; preserve immutable historical evidence/assets.
cases.forbidden: Rewrite historical acceptance, weaken leaf safety, or migrate unnamed consumers.
